title: Kate Ryan, the Glessners' cook, at the foot of the service stair
items: Kate Ryan, the Irish cook the 1900 census finds in the house at 1800 Prairie, now stands in the courtyard at the foot of the service stair. Walk up to her to open her card.

She is in her own working dress, after older cooks photographed in 1901 and 1903: a dark print dress with the sleeves rolled up, a broad checked apron wrapped round the skirt, and a cloth tied over her hair.
